verdict.rationale: The product officially offers Docker self-hosting. A release note fixing k8s probes suggests Kubernetes manifests are maintained, but neither path is shown as a dedicated maintained guide. Missing for 10: dedicated Docker Compose guide, Helm chart or Kubernetes deployment guide, small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence that each guide is maintained.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide

citations.quote: fix: point k8s probes at the server's /api/ping
